|errata_history={{Card errata/Courage Of A Skywalker (V)}}
This is the original printing: the PC card image current at the set's official release (8 August 2025), first published 7 August 2025. It is not the current version; the current text is [[Courage Of A Skywalker (V) (Errata)]] (PC-E1). The image is the PC card image of this version.
* '''Original''' (this page): PC card image of 7 August 2025<ref name="ht-cs-0">PC card image in the PC's Holotable image set: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/7821822/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual25-Light/large/courageofaskywalker.gif courageofaskywalker.gif], commit [https://api.github.com/repos/swccgpc/holotable/git/commits/782182256b44863b5363404bf248c0502ee71360 7821822] (7 August 2025).</ref>, no errata mark.  Text: “If a [Skywalker] Effect on table, destiny +2 when drawn for destiny. Take a lightsaber into hand from Force Pile; reshuffle. OR Retrieve Anakin's Lightsaber. OR Once per game, during a battle or duel involving a Skywalker and a Dark Jedi, make a just drawn destiny = 2.”
*: The lower part of this card image (the bars and game-text box down to the lower-left name) was also printed as a slip on the Players Committee's Virtual Set 25 release sheet<ref name="sheet25-20250810">Players Committee, [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-25.pdf Virtual Set 25 release sheet] (PDF, 10 pages, footer “SWCCG Players Committee, August 2025”; file created 10 August 2025). Released with [[Virtual Set 25]] (8 August 2025); the PDF is dated by its creation date.</ref>, page 8, file created 10 August 2025, under the label “•Courage Of A Skywalker”. Same words ([[:File:V25-L-courageofaskywalker-2025-08-10-sheet-slip.png]]). Under the slip-and-composite rule (Bill, 17 November 2026) the slip is part of this version, not a version of its own.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Courage Of A Skywalker (V) (Errata)]]): PC card image of 9 March 2026<ref name="ht-cs-1">PC card image in the PC's Holotable image set: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/6f23e07/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual25-Light/large/courageofaskywalker.gif courageofaskywalker.gif], commit [https://api.github.com/repos/swccgpc/holotable/git/commits/6f23e077ed3f1bb8f34b62099641028868d7a2ae 6f23e07] (9 March 2026).</ref>, marked “E1”. What changed from the previous image: PC Tweak Set errata (marked “E1”): the whole text is replaced. “If a [Skywalker] Effect on table, destiny +2 when drawn for destiny.” and “Take a lightsaber into hand from Force Pile; reshuffle. OR Retrieve Anakin's Lightsaber.” become “If your Skywalker in battle alone with a character of greater ability, add one battle destiny. OR Deploy a lightsaber on a Skywalker from Lost Pile (or Force Pile; reshuffle).”; the last option drops “and a Dark Jedi”. Text: “If your Skywalker in battle alone with a character of greater ability, add one battle destiny. OR Deploy a lightsaber on a Skywalker from Lost Pile (or Force Pile; reshuffle). OR Once per game, during a battle or duel involving a Skywalker, make a just drawn destiny = 2.”
Versions follow Bill's ruling of 12 November 2026: every visible change on a PC card image is a version (the PC's own E marks count only its announced errata).
